correct_diagnosis: Essential hypertension, not controlled on amlodipine monotherapy
matching_criterion: Essential (primary) hypertension that is not controlled on calcium-channel-blocker monotherapy. Any wording that names uncontrolled/inadequately controlled hypertension counts as correct; a secondary cause named as the diagnosis does not.

management_reference.management: Intensify drug therapy with a combination: a renin-angiotensin-system blocker (ACE inhibitor or ARB) added to the calcium-channel blocker.
management_reference.source_quote: Ideal combination therapy includes renin-angiotensin-system (RAS) blocker with calcium channel-blocker (CCB) or thiazide/thiazide-like diuretics

management_reference.management: Reinforce lifestyle changes (sodium restriction, weight and exercise) as the first line of antihypertensive treatment, together with drugs.
management_reference.source_quote: Healthy lifestyle choices are the first line of antihypertensive treatment

management_reference.management: Advise sodium restriction (as low as 1500 mg/day).
management_reference.source_quote: Sodium restriction to as low as 1500 mg/day

management_scoring_note: Only items with a verified source quote are scored; general good practice that the article does not state is not scored.
